conventions: Every new .ts, .tsx, and .css source file starts with the 15-line Backstage Apache-2.0 block header with 'Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors'; existing files keep their original copyright year unchanged.
Use ESM named exports (except alpha.tsx default export for createFrontendPlugin); keep barrel index.ts files to re-exports only.

In plugins/notifications, use @backstage/ui components (Flex, Text, ButtonIcon, Tooltip, TooltipTrigger), @backstage/core-components (Link, Progress, ResponseErrorPanel), @remixicon/react icons, CSS Modules wrapped in @layer components using active --bui-* tokens (never deprecated tokens like --bui-bg-info or --bui-bg-solid), and useTranslationRef(notificationsTranslationRef) from @backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha.

In jsdom unit tests, use describe/it with screen and findBy* queries from @testing-library/react, TestApiProvider / renderInTestApp from @backstage/test-utils, and never add data-testid attributes to implementation files.

Follow docs/contribute/doc-style-guide.md in Markdown and changesets: U.S. English, sentence-case headings, present tense, active voice, backticks for package/file/code names, no Latin abbreviations (e.g., i.e.), no words like 'new', 'currently', 'just', 'simply', or 'easily', and no internal symbol names in changesets.

decisions.choice: Default UnreadNotificationsCard item limit to 5 (DEFAULT_LIMIT = 5, configurable via optional limit?: number prop on UnreadNotificationsCardProps), fetching via notificationsApi.getNotifications({ read: false, limit, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc' }).
decisions.reason: Matches NotificationsPage.tsx line 88 (pageSize defaults to 5) and lines 85 and 91 (unreadOnly = true and SortByOptions.newest.sortBy).

decisions.choice: Default polling fallback interval to 30000 ms (DEFAULT_POLLING_INTERVAL_MS = 30_000, configurable via optional pollingIntervalMs?: number prop on UnreadNotificationsCardProps) when isSignalsAvailable is false, and throttle signal-triggered refreshes with lodash/throttle using ThrottleDelayMs = 2000.
decisions.reason: Follows NotificationsSideBarItem.tsx line 176 (TODO noting no polling interval existed yet when signals are unavailable) and NotificationsPage.tsx lines 54 and 143-159 (ThrottleDelayMs = 2000 with lodash/throttle for signal refreshes).

decisions.choice: Display 'No records to display' (via unreadNotificationsCard.emptyMessage in notificationsTranslationRef) when zero unread notifications are returned, while keeping the 'View all notifications' link (unreadNotificationsCard.viewAll) to useRouteRef(rootRouteRef)() (/notifications) visible.

units.behaviour: Render an InfoCard listing unread notifications with links to /notifications?id=<id>, per-item mark-as-read action, live signal refresh, and polling fallback.
rules: 1. Include the Apache-2.0 license header at the top of the file.

2. Export UnreadNotificationsCardProps ({ title?: string; limit?: number; pollingIntervalMs?: number; className?: string }) and UnreadNotificationsCard(props: UnreadNotificationsCardProps = {}): JSX.Element.
3. Use useNotificationsApi to call api.getNotifications({ read: false, limit, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc' }) where limit defaults to 5, re-running when limit or a refresh counter changes.

4. Subscribe with useSignal('notifications'); when lastSignal?.action exists, trigger a throttled refresh via lodash/throttle with ThrottleDelayMs = 2000 (matching NotificationsPage.tsx) and cancel the throttled function on unmount.

5. Check isSignalsAvailable from useSignal('notifications'); when isSignalsAvailable is false and pollingIntervalMs > 0 (default 30_000), register a window.setInterval that increments the refresh counter every pollingIntervalMs and clear it on unmount or when signals become available.

6. Render an InfoCard from '@backstage/core-components' with title={props.title ?? t('unreadNotificationsCard.title')} and className={props.className}, displaying <Progress /> while loading on initial fetch, <ResponseErrorPanel error={error} /> on fetch error, t('unreadNotificationsCard.emptyMessage') ('No records to display') when notifications is empty, or the list of unread notifications.

7. For each notification item, render its payload.title inside a Link from '@backstage/core-components' pointing to `${notificationsLink}?id=${encodeURIComponent(notification.id)}` (using useRouteRef(rootRouteRef) with a safe fallback to '/notifications' if the route ref is not mounted), optional payload.description and relative created time via <RelativeTime value={notification.created} /> from 'react-relative-time' (imported with // @ts-ignore as in NotificationsTable.tsx), and an action button with aria-label={t('unreadNotificationsCard.markAsRead')} and RiCheckLine from '@remixicon/react' that calls notificationsApi.updateNotifications({ ids: [notification.id], read: true }), removes or refreshes the item on success, and reports errors via useApi(toastApiRef).post({ title: t('unreadNotificationsCard.errorMarkAsRead'), status: 'danger' }).
8. Render a footer/bottom Link to notificationsLink ('/notifications') with text t('unreadNotificationsCard.viewAll') in both populated and empty states.
